en.headline: Air India Crash Probe Nears End
en.hook: Investigation into Air India crash nearing completion
en.what: The Centre has announced that the investigation into the Air India crash is almost complete. A report is still awaited. The investigation has been ongoing to determine the cause of the crash.
en.why: The completion of the investigation is crucial to understanding the circumstances surrounding the crash. Young Indians can expect to learn more about the incident once the report is released.

ml.headline: Air India Crash Anveshanam Fag Endil
ml.hook: Air India crash investigation umakkanam samayam kettu
ml.what: Kendrabhoothal Air India crash anveshanam purnaavasthayil erikkunnu. Report innale varan pokunnu. Crash yude karanam arinjekkukaan anveshanam nadakkunnu.
ml.why: Anveshanam samapikkuka anu crash yude sthithi manasilaakkan. Report publish aakkum pothum, yuvavargal arinjekkum.
